garden_check.name: Mansion Garden Check
garden_check.price_note: Founder order 2026-10-24: one-time, low price ("$10 or $20 or something"). This one number sets every price shown for the Garden Check, on every page and in catalog.json. Change it here only.
garden_check.payment_link_note: Paste the Stripe Payment Link URL (https://buy.stripe.com/...) here. Empty = the site shows 'Book a Garden Check' and takes a booking request; filled = card checkout, and catalog.json marks it LIVE.
garden_check.tagline: Like an oil change for your website: pull in, 5–10 minutes, done.
garden_check.summary: A quick live check of your website on a video call. You watch while we go through it, then we tell you plainly what needs fixing and what doesn't.
checks: Links and buttons that go nowhere
Speed on a phone and on a computer
How it looks and works on a phone
Search basics: titles, descriptions, your name, address and phone
how: Book a time and send your website address
We meet on Zoom or Google Meet; you watch the whole check
We go through your site, one area at a time
You get a plain list: what needs fixing, and what doesn't
garden_check.privacy: Your logins stay yours: we never ask for passwords; everything we look at stays private between us; you can watch the whole check live.
garden_check.fixes_note: Fixes are quoted separately, and only if you want them. Nothing is changed on your site during the check.

monthly.name: Mansion Garden Pass
monthly.note: Want it every month? The Mansion Garden Pass checks your whole site once a month and fixes what it finds. It is included with Passport Pro ($50 a month).
